hero_headline: Crack the civil services. From Chandigarh.
hero_subtext: Expert mentors, disciplined test practice and honest guidance for aspirants across Punjab, Haryana and Himachal.
founder_headline: Preparation is a discipline, not a talent.
founder_message: Every year I meet aspirants who are as capable as any topper; what they lack is a plan and someone who tells them the truth about their preparation. At CCS we build both: a plan you can follow every day and mentors who review your work honestly. Come and speak to us. Your first counselling session is free.
cta_headline: Start your preparation the right way
cta_subtext: Share your details and our counsellor will call you within 24 hours.
cta_points: A personalised study plan for your attempt year
Free access to notes, PYQs and weekly tests
